title: Anurag Soni v. State of Chhattisgarh

content.caseIdentity: Anurag Soni v. State of Chhattisgarh, (2019) 10 SCC 326
content.holding: Held that where an accused made a promise of marriage to the prosecutrix while already having arranged his marriage with another woman, his promise was demonstrably false ab initio and designed purely to induce sexual relations, establishing criminal deceit.

sources.label: Supreme Court of India authoritative judgment PDF

verificationNote: Original Supreme Court judgment inspected; official PDF identifies Criminal Appeal No.629/2019, judgment dated 09-Apr-2019 and the conviction context. The Court addresses consent obtained on a misconception of fact where a promise to marry was false from inception.
